title: Woodlands RV Park and River Marina

services.name: small cabin
services.desc: Whether you’re planning a quiet night on the water or need a cozy spot for visiting guests, our cabins offer a restful, riverside escape-just steps from the shoreline. Cabins come fully furnished with beds, basic kitchenware, linens, and towels. Each unit also includes heating, and access to a firepit. Each cabin has a set occupancy limit. services.name: RV site
services.desc: Woodlands RV Park & Marina sits right on the Athabasca River, offering on-site fishing just steps from your campsite. It doesn’t get any better than this!! That’s not just a slogan-it’s something we hear from guests all summer long. Whether you’re a family introducing your kids to fishing or a seasoned angler seeking a trophy catch, the Athabasca River at Woodlands has something for you. The stretch of the Athabasca River by Fort Assiniboine is teeming with a variety of fish. You’ll commonly reel in walleye, northern pike, goldeye, Rocky Mountain whitefish, Arctic grayling, and burbot. From hard-fighting game fish to smaller, eager biters, there’s something for everyone. Walleye and pike
